recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-5856 unless a work group separately decides to revise broader profiling terminology.
issue_request: FHIR-5856 was a Published technical correction with Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked that the profiling Limitations of Use wording replace "Profiles" with StructureDefinition language, while the Jira comment cautioned that not every use of "Profile" should be replaced because Profile can refer to packages.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-5856-tagged source commit was found. Commit 2b54214b7e0f128262e318bbc7001a603096fd4b changed the relevant Limitations sentence from "What profiles can do" to "What Structure Definitions can do when they are constraining existing resources and datatypes", and commit 6ba53e94c5cfafb45448eef3c6d1ca463d5ab287 later normalized it to "StructureDefinitions".
additional_context: The current source/profiling.html Limitations of Use section already uses StructureDefinitions terminology. source/fhir.ini lists StructureDefinition as an active resource, a later profiling-page change preserved the wording, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current specification already conveys the requested StructureDefinition wording, and broader replacement of remaining "Profiles" text would exceed the Jira request and conflict with the Jira comment.

related_jiras.note: Encountered only as a later profiling.html commit that preserved the same Limitations wording; not decided because it is a separate broader wording issue.
